title: Minh's Happy Life
description: Review of hobbies, healthy living and community service; present simple and past simple.
content:
Minh is a thirteen-year-old boy from Da Nang. He is active and happy.

Minh's hobby is collecting stamps. He has more than 300 stamps from different countries. He enjoys looking at them every evening. He says this hobby makes him patient.

Minh also has healthy habits. He eats a lot of fruit and vegetables, and he avoids soft drinks. He plays football with his friends every Saturday, so he stays fit.

Last month, Minh joined a volunteer project at his school. He and his classmates collected old books and gave them to children in a mountain village. They also taught the children some simple English songs. Minh felt proud because he helped other people.

Next month, he wants to join another project and plant trees in his neighbourhood.

questions.explanation: Paragraph 2 says Minh has more than 300 stamps from different countries.

options.B: He plays football with his friends.

questions.explanation: Paragraph 4 says Minh and his classmates collected old books.

questions.explanation: Paragraph 4 says they taught the children some simple English songs.

questions.question_text: What is the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage describes Minh's hobby, healthy habits and community activities that make him happy.

options.C: Minh's hobby, healthy habits and community activity

questions.explanation: Paragraph 2 describes Minh's hobby, paragraph 3 describes his healthy habits, and paragraph 4 describes his community project.
The sentence says Minh avoids soft drinks, meaning he stays away from them or does not drink them.
Playing football regularly helps Minh stay in good shape and healthy.
Minh felt proud because he helped other people, meaning he was pleased about what he had done.

questions.question_text: What can we infer about Minh?

options.A: He has a balanced and positive life.

questions.explanation: Minh has a hobby, healthy habits and takes part in volunteer work. The passage also describes him as active and happy.

questions.question_text: Why did the students probably give old books to children in a mountain village?

options.A: Because the children had too many books.
options.B: Because the children may not have many books to read.
options.C: Because the students did not like reading.

questions.explanation: The students gave books to children in a mountain village, suggesting that the children may have needed more books to read. This is implied rather than directly stated.

questions.explanation: True. Paragraph 2 says Minh has more than 300 stamps from different countries.

questions.explanation: False. The passage says Minh avoids soft drinks.

questions.explanation: False. The passage says Minh joined the volunteer project last month, not last year.

questions.question_text: Minh plays football at a sports club.
questions.explanation: Not Given. The passage says Minh plays football with his friends every Saturday but does not say where he plays.
